comment_corrections: /** Expose panel/detector outputs on native GT hosts without their own cover signal dispatch. */
/** Exposes emitting cover outputs through BlockState; basic machines and signal wires keep their own paths. */

readability.limit: Whitespace, listed local/parameter renames and one source-backed comment correction; gameplay and literal values unchanged.

finite_source_witnesses.kind: Finite source-contract branches only, no target Java calls or world fixture.

conduction.condition: No covers, one correctly oriented powered lever gives15 direct signal into a full relay cube; query another face. Six non-redstone variants, six input faces, five other output faces, two platforms.
conduction.limit: Original comparison is the explicit MTE weak-power opt-out plus own0 output contract, not a run of Minecraft1.7.10.

bridge_sided.limit: 576 shared one-hot source layouts and query-side cases; no native conductor or cover overlays.

bridge_native_projection.limit: Horizontal modern native comparator callers all take unsided max. Original side is a declared GT block/BE query contract; no1.7.10 native comparator runtime is claimed.

snapshot_transitions.condition: 30255 has already sampled0 or15; only its front input changes before its next onTick2/tickSignals. Query raw route methods without covers or conductor merge.
snapshot_transitions.limit: Not a measured tick latency or global feedback/stability result. Existing thread-local cycle guard is retained.

positive_routes: The shared weak-output opposite-side formula agrees for bridge raw reads; internal relays preserve a sided comparator call.
Nonbridge primary front/back aggregation agrees after a fresh sample and without another change; pending difference is cached versus live timing.
Actual server ticker checksEXTENDER type and calls tickSignals; changed outputs call both updateNeighborsAt and updateNeighbourForOutputSignal. Do not report all notifications missing.
Source getDirectSignal supplies only coverStrongSignal; current indirect conduction comes from native SignalGetter merging neighboring strong input, not direct GT RU/KU energy conversion.
Existing loaded guards and per-thread signal visits/finally cleanup are retained. CoverSignalMixin has explicit output-cover selection and excludes basic machines/signal wires.
remaining: Minecraft1.7.10 engine end-to-end comparison, real six-face wires/comparators/strong sources, all cover overlays and notification order, chunk loading/restarts, feedback timing policy and the full project queue.
limits: No Java compilation/initialization, Gradle, tests, game, world fixture, build or push. javap only disassembles saved upstream artifacts.
Three readability sources change whitespace, scoped names and one comment; all six full execution/literal views remain unchanged.
Source findings are recorded, not gameplay fixes. The complete original-alignment/readability goal remains active.

root_validation.limit: Source/file analysis only; no Java compilation/initialization, Gradle, tests, game or old engine fixture, real tick timing, build or push.
